source.resolution: Body Colors, Elevation & Depth and component states override the approximate YAML palette; light mode is derived. Button hover/pressed keep the established action-primary semantic recipes so product brand overrides inherit all states.

changes: Clarify action-primary-foreground in the role table.
Map destructive component variant to existing action-danger/action-danger-foreground; distinguish soft danger.
Add a separately marked compatible lifecycle/build-consumption section; inverse reconstruction removes only that section and the recorded clarifications. All marked default CSS bytes preserved.
Clarify first-party API scope and industry-standard/third-party precedence in a separately marked paragraph. Inverse reconstruction removes exactly this recorded paragraph; default CSS unchanged.

Add four derived shell/header semantic tokens in the marked shell-role-tokens block and role composition rules in the removable lifecycle section; inverse reconstruction removes that token block and preserves the original 271 default token bytes.

Add separately marked typed typography scaling and centralized component design tokens. Inverse reconstruction removes only the recorded new token/registration blocks and restores typographyOriginalCss and the exact component scale clarification, retaining the original source SHA256.
Adopt authorized responsive overlay width ratios and independent vertical-sheet height; inverse reconstruction restores the recorded width definitions and exact descriptive clarifications.

Refine the public login hierarchy in the centralized component token block: an independent 32/40 entry-title role, 400px form and compact post-action feedback. Global page-title and seven shared typography roles remain unchanged.

Replace the split login surface with a centered natural-height single-column card: derived 450px maximum width, 24px card padding, 32px identity logo, compact optional 80px visual and a fixed token-scaled 48px feedback track. Remove obsolete panel/group scroll-size tokens; fullscreen retains the same column without a card surface.

Bound only a single extreme configured login action to max(control-height-lg, 20dvh), with internal label scrolling and a bounded state-reservation grid. The brand, form and action group remain natural height; default control and card geometry are unchanged.

Rework public AuthPage hierarchy after screenshot and reference review: task description follows 28/36 title, brand/labels use existing 14/22 role, input/primary reuse existing 16/26 role with derived 44px minimum, 384px content and 434px card, 40px feedback and 12px bottom padding. Add six semantic layout/control aliases in the removable component token block; global colors and typography roots unchanged.

Add derived button-padding-block-xs in the removable centralized component token block, using existing xs height, body-sm line height and the actual surface border width; no original token default changed.

Add three matching system-color Progress roles and one pending-border-style role in the removable centralized component block, with separately marked forced-colors accessibility bindings. Preserve ordinary-mode tokens and native value/max semantics; use forced-color-adjust:auto and an unfilled pending track.

Add derived dialog-body-min-block-size in the removable centralized block; existing control height and focus reach define the single-owner whole-dialog fallback threshold without fixed content heights.

componentScaleClarification.before: 尺寸由spacing及control-height/icon-size、radius、文字角色或必要组件变量表达：例如Switch宽calc(spacing×7)、高calc(spacing×4.15)，Tabs内距calc(spacing×0.75)；不为每个常量另建一层变量。
componentScaleClarification.after: 尺寸由spacing及control-height/icon-size、radius、文字角色或必要组件变量表达；设计倍率仅在集中token定义中计算，例如switch-width、switch-height、tabs-padding，组件直接消费对应var。结构常量与实时测量例外见公共设计值验收边界。

responsiveContractClarifications.before: 弹层512/384/736，视口边16；是可覆盖默认约束
responsiveContractClarifications.after: 弹层宽度按40%/30%/60%及各自rem上下限，视口边16；是可覆盖默认约束

responsiveContractClarifications.before: 复杂详情可保留明确的736px变体
responsiveContractClarifications.after: 侧向Sheet宽60%（24–64rem）并封顶视口，上下Sheet高度独立
宽layout-dialog/confirm/drawer-width按40%/30%/60%与各自min/max合成；Dialog/Confirm边距16，侧向Sheet封顶视口

changes: Adopt the authorized Precision Engineering Console as the default theme in both modes.
Preserve semantic names and complete light/dark/system, reduced-motion and forced-colors mappings.
Use independent accessible input borders and readable header/placeholder/error foregrounds.
Use 4px controls, 6px cards and 8px overlays; retain published type scales and login geometry.
Add explicit table header/row/stripe roles and source fingerprints; historical source reconstruction remains verifiable.
Retain semantic button hover/pressed derivation from action-primary for existing product brand overrides; do not introduce fixed palette state tokens.
Expose explicit passive Badge status tones through existing status foreground/soft/line roles; neutral metadata and Tag stay plain.

Refine the shared single-column AuthPage from the supplied Stitch reference: 13/20 muted brand and labels, existing page-title 20/28 and body-sm 14/22 controls, 16px heading-to-fields gap, 2px semantic primary top border, and no empty feedback reservation. Remove the superseded login title and feedback-height tokens; preserve user font scaling and natural document scrolling. Derive login-group-input-height centrally so the group border is included in the 44px minimum.
